mapper.select: SELECT id, tenant_id, user_id, plan_id, sku_id, status, auto_renew, start_time, current_period_start, current_period_end, benefit_anchor_time, next_renew_time, cancel_at_period_end, cancel_time, pending_plan_id, pending_sku_id, pending_effective_time, provider, agreement_no, plan_snapshot_json, source_order_no, version, create_by, create_time, update_by, update_time, deleted FROM ai_user_subscription WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND status IN ('active', 'canceling', 'past_due') AND deleted = 0 ORDER BY id DESC LIMIT 1 FOR UPDATE
